pytest_command_note: verbatim from PODSIM_CMD. Test SELECTION is the session's own SESSION_TEST_IGNORES; --junitxml is appended by the simulator as a reporting flag so every skip and pass can be named exactly.
record_kind_note: diagnostic: proves the pod-like suite passes on this exact tree and that the readiness machinery works. A launch-bound record is the one a maintainer-approved C1 launch rests on. It is produced on the final CLEAN PRE-AUTHORIZATION tree -- after the grant and all metadata are committed, BEFORE the authorization is issued -- because a sweep run after issuance adds a second path to the lineage diff and session_commit_gate refuses.
setup_environment_source: SessionSpec.setup_environment(session_commit=<swept HEAD>, bundle=canonical_bundle_name(<swept HEAD>)) -- the same production method SessionRunner._launch calls. Not a reconstructed subset. No secret is stored: none of these keys carries one.

staging_contract_rule: derived from spec(args).setup -- the same SetupManifest the SessionRunner launches.
